hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: SDDOT publishes no crash cost per KABCO level. Its 2019 research report (SD2019-02, Table 'SDDOT average $ value per crash') uses one US DOT 2020 value for every fatal or injury crash ($395,313) and $18,491 per property-damage crash: not a per-level table

statewide_rates.missing: no statewide average crash-rate table by facility type found (2026-11-08); SDDOT ranks counties by injury-crash rate per VMT (HSIP report), and CrashIQ has no South Dakota traffic counts

screening.state_method: Roadway Safety Improvement (RSI) inspections of locations with 5 or more crashes (animal hits excluded) in the latest 3 years, Road Safety Audits, and a Safety Module using the HSM rural two-lane predictive method (SDDOT HSIP reports)

min_years.page: Program Methodology (RSI: 'five or more crashes ... in the most current three year period')

spf_calibration.missing: SDDOT's Safety Module calibration not published; no SPF engine
